notes:
- Company snapshot: mid-market B2B search/SaaS product for vertical marketplaces. Heavily focused on improving conversion via better relevance.
- Current stack: elasticsearch for retrieval + homegrown re-ranker; working to move heavy compute off infra to reduce ops.
- Primary interest: Redwood reranking endpoints to replace internal ranker for online re-ranking (low-latency) and Redwood Dedicated for predictable costs at scale. Also evaluating offline scoring on Dedicated (nightly re-score of ~2M items).
- POC ask: 1) Hosted API proof of concept to validate rerank endpoint correctness on their eval set (NDCG@10, MRR), 2) Dedicated sizing quote for steady QPS 40-80 with bursts to 200 QPS and p50 latency target <=180ms for rerank-only path.
- Eval set: ~25k queries, each with 100 candidate documents; current baseline NDCG@10=0.42. Want +10-15% improvement before committing.
- Data flow: candidate generation in their infra -> call Redwood rerank endpoint with IDs + features -> apply scores and return top K. Need support for candidate-level metadata and custom features (dense vectors + categorical signals).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML for console, SOC2 attestation, audit logs for token usage, option to bring own KMS. EU customer data residency requirement for a subset of tenants.
- Pricing sensitivity: tight margin; evaluating per-token/per-request vs committed Dedicated cost. Interested in model-variant routing to lower-cost quantized models for low-sensitivity traffic.
- Quote request: committed Dedicated monthly cost for 4x A100-equivalent GPUs, burst pool to 8 GPUs, and 99.9% SLA. Also request cost delta for enabling offline batch scoring for 2m items nightly.
- "We need a measurable improvement on our eval set before we can justify moving off homegrown ranker" - Head of Product (Lucas Chen).
- Internal champions: Head of Product Lucas Chen (exec sponsor), Senior Eng Lead Nora Kim (technical), ML Lead Rafael Gomez (owns evals).
- Risks: integration complexity for candidate features, SAML timeline (their IdP team is slow), and legal/data residency approvals for EU tenants.
- Success criteria for POC: +10% NDCG@10 OR 5pt MRR lift on production-ish traffic, P50 rerank latency <=180ms at 80 QPS, and predictable cost estimate for 12-month commit.
